definitions.explanation: A formal prayer or ritual performed to ask for divine blessing, healing, protection, or other spiritual favor. Often performed by a priest or religious practitioner at a shrine or temple.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{祈祷|きとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: To receive a prayer at a shrine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦{祈願|きがん}→祈願：13745_kigan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祈祷|きとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いした→お願いする：05654_onegaisuru⟧。
examples.english: I requested a prayer for safety.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{祈祷|きとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧だ。
examples.english: It is our annual custom to go as a family to receive a New Year's prayer.

notes:
A formal religious prayer or ritual, typically performed by a Shinto priest (⟦{神主|かんぬし}→神主：16732_kannushi⟧) at a shrine or by a Buddhist priest at a temple. The person requesting the prayer usually pays a fee ({初穂料|はつほりょう} at Shinto shrines).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {祈祷|きとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a prayer (from a priest)
- {祈祷|きとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to perform a prayer
- {祈祷|きとう}⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧: prayer fee
- {祈祷|きとう}{師|し}: prayer healer; spiritual practitioner
- ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧{祈祷|きとう}: prayer for safety

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, {祈祷|きとう} is commonly performed at life milestones and seasonal events: ⟦{初詣|はつもうで}→初詣：05804_hatsumoude⟧ (New Year's shrine visit), ⟦{七五三|しちごさん}→七五三：06185_shichigosan⟧ (children's festival), ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祈祷|きとう} (blessing of a new car), and ⟦{地鎮祭|じちんさい}→地鎮祭：30680_jichinsai⟧ (ground-breaking ceremony). It is distinct from personal, informal prayer.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{祈|いの}り→祈り：13732_inori⟧: prayer — more general and personal; can be done by anyone
- ⟦お{参|まい}り→お参り：16837_omairi⟧: visiting a shrine/temple to pray — the visit itself rather than a formal ritual
- ⟦{祈願|きがん}→祈願：13745_kigan⟧: votive prayer — making a specific wish or request to a deity
